search_audit.outcome: Search found an exact 圖 seal-script Commons result and official Unihan documentation. Direct opens of Commons description pages returned cache misses; all three character-specific Unihan page attempts were inaccessible.

Search result content for 圖-seal.svg describes a modern vector in Shuowen seal style and reports source references and CC0 1.0, but direct opens of the seal, slip, bronze, and big-seal description pages all returned cache misses. No image candidate is selected because exact description pages could not be inspected.

gaps: The supplied local kMandarin rows support the Modern Mandarin comparison 啚 bǐ / 圖 tú, but the official Unicode character-specific records for U+5569, U+5716, and U+56FE could not be accessed. The pair is current metadata and does not establish an ancient phonetic relationship.

Commons search surfaced a plausible 圖 seal-script vector, but direct exact description-page access returned cache misses. Consequently its provenance and rights could not be checked sufficiently to propose it as a glyph candidate; the character-specific Xiaoxuetang record was not independently inspected either.

No external exact-row Baxter–Sagart record for 啚 was found in this run. Retain the reviewed conclusion that the supplied comparison is current Mandarin only and that the historical sound-role claim remains unresolved.

limitations.text: No candidate is selected: the exact Commons description pages failed to open, so the search-result summary alone is insufficient to verify image identity, source provenance, or reuse rights. The supplied earlier dossier also reports that the Xiaoxuetang character-specific record did not load.
